test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sql_json_initialized_tail (short_json String, long_json String) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sql_json_initialized_tail SELECT concat('{{"sparam":"test_string","nparam":', toString(number % 1000), '}}'), concat('{{"sparam":"test_string","nparam":', toString(number % 1000), ',"pad":"', repeat('x', 4053 - length(toString(number % 1000))), '"}}') FROM numbers(32768)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM sql_json_initialized_tail WHERE NOT ignore(JSON_VALUE(short_json, '$.nparam'))
SELECT count() FROM sql_json_initialized_tail WHERE JSON_EXISTS(short_json, '$.nparam')
SELECT count() FROM sql_json_initialized_tail WHERE NOT ignore(JSON_VALUE(long_json, '$.nparam'))
SELECT count() FROM sql_json_initialized_tail WHERE JSON_EXISTS(long_json, '$.nparam')
